description: Generate a slide-deck-quality SWOT analysis laid out as the classic 2×2 grid: Strengths (top left) and Weaknesses (top right) as the internal row, Opportunities (bottom left) and Threats (bottom right) as the external row, each a softly tinted panel with its big coloured letter and up to 8 bullets, with optional Helpful / Harmful and Internal / External axis labels, an optional subject ("Acme Coffee, FY26") and an optional one-line conclusion underneath. Choose it to assess a company, product, team, project or person for a strategy, business-plan, marketing or coursework slide; use Porter's five forces (create_five_forces) for the pressures on a whole industry, a Harvey ball matrix to score options against criteria, and an issue tree to break one problem down. Only `strengths` is required (an empty [] is fine), but fill all four; infer 3–5 bullets each from context rather than asking. Limits: 8 bullets per quadrant of about 3–8 words, a conclusion of one sentence. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

inputSchema.description: A SWOT analysis as the classic 2×2 grid: Strengths and Weaknesses (internal) on top, Opportunities and Threats (external) below, each with up to 8 bullets, plus optional axis labels, a subject line and a conclusion.

examples.conclusion: Go after office wholesale, but fund a second roaster first
opportunities: Offices restocking coffee after hybrid return
strengths: Loyal following at our two cafés
examples.subject: Northside Roasters, FY26
threats: Green coffee prices at a 40-year high
examples.title: SWOT: wholesale expansion

colors.description: Optional colour overrides per quadrant, as hex, e.g. { "threats": "#b91c1c" }. Each colours that quadrant's stripe, letter, bullet dots and tint. Default: emerald, amber, sky and red (or the brand palette).

conclusion.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown in a muted band under the grid, e.g. "Lead with wholesale to offices; fund a second roaster first". Wraps to 2 lines. Omit for none.

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

labels.description: Show the axis labels: "Helpful" and "Harmful" over the columns, "Internal" and "External" beside the rows. Default true.

look.description: Drawing style, the same in every tool. "regular": clean lines and Inter (the default). "bold": heavier, slightly larger type and thicker lines, for slides read from a distance. "sketch": hand-drawn, with a handwriting font and pen lines that wobble a little, for early ideas and workshops. Use the one the user asks for; otherwise leave it out.

opportunities.description: External, helpful: trends or openings the subject could use, e.g. ["Offices restocking coffee after hybrid return"]. 0–8 short phrases. Bottom-left quadrant. Default [].

palette.description: Hex colours. With the default palette the quadrants are emerald (S), amber (W), sky (O) and red (T); pass brand colours and they apply in order S, W, O, T instead. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

strengths.description: Required (may be empty []). Internal, helpful: what the subject does well or owns, e.g. ["Award-winning single-origin range", "Loyal café following"]. 0–8 short phrases of about 3–8 words; long ones wrap to 3 lines. Top-left quadrant.

subject.description: Optional subject of the analysis, e.g. "Northside Roasters, FY26", shown small and muted in the title row's right corner (or above the grid when the title is long). Omit for none.

threats.description: External, harmful: what could hurt the subject, e.g. ["Green coffee prices at a 40-year high"]. 0–8 short phrases. Bottom-right quadrant. Default [].

title.description: Heading shown top-left of the chart at 22px bold. Every chart has one title row; an empty string hides it.

weaknesses.description: Internal, harmful: what holds the subject back, e.g. ["One roaster, near capacity"]. 0–8 short phrases. Top-right quadrant. Default [].

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400, default 1280, which suits a 16:9 slide). PNG output renders at 2x. Height is computed from the content.

inputSchema.title: SWOT Analysis
